name: Quote Desk Agent
short: Answers quote requests in minutes, with real prices from your catalog.
problem: A quote request comes in at 4:47pm. It sits in a shared inbox until tomorrow. By then the buyer has three other quotes.
outcome: Every request gets a correct, formatted quote or a qualified handoff to a human inside minutes, 24 hours a day.
bullets: Reads the request from email, web form, or chat
Pulls pricing and specs from your catalog, price list, or ERP export
Drafts the quote in your template, sends or routes for approval
Logs the lead in GoHighLevel and schedules the follow-up
Hands off to a person when it is not sure, with the context attached
deliverables: Working agent on your inbox and site

name: Reorder Follow-up Agent
short: Reaches out before the customer runs out, and chases quotes that went quiet.
problem: Repeat customers reorder late or from someone else. Sent quotes get no reply and nobody has time to chase.
outcome: Timed, personal follow-ups on every open quote and every predictable reorder, with replies routed back to your team.
bullets: Follow-up sequences on every open quote, by email and SMS
Reorder reminders based on order history and typical usage
Replies classified and routed: order, question, not now, unsubscribe
Everything tracked in GoHighLevel pipelines
Weekly summary of what converted and what stalled
deliverables: Order history import and reorder model

name: AI Receptionist
short: Answers the phone and the chat, books the call, takes the order details.
problem: Calls go to voicemail during busy hours. Website chat is a dead widget. Buyers move on.
outcome: A voice and chat agent that answers instantly, knows your products, books time with the right rep, and never forgets to log the conversation.
bullets: Voice agent on your main line or an overflow line
Chat agent on your site with your catalog loaded
Books meetings on your reps' calendars
Captures order and account details into GoHighLevel
Escalates to a human with a transcript
deliverables: Voice and chat agent configured and tested
Knowledge base from your catalog and FAQs

name: GoHighLevel Systems
short: Your CRM, pipelines, automations, and reporting, built and running in GHL.
problem: Leads live in inboxes, spreadsheets, and someone's head. Nothing is measured.
outcome: One system where every lead, quote, order, and follow-up lives, with automations doing the repetitive parts.
bullets: Pipelines for quotes, orders, and reactivation
Lead intake from site, email, phone, and imports
Automated tasks, reminders, and notifications
Dashboards your team actually opens
Migration from HubSpot, Zoho, spreadsheets

name: Custom Apps and Sites
short: Internal tools, customer portals, and sites built with AI, shipped fast, owned by you.
problem: The tool you need does not exist, or the one you have costs per seat and does half the job.
outcome: Software built for your exact process. Portals, dashboards, integrations, and marketing sites. No seat fees, ever.
bullets: Customer reorder portals and quote lookup
Internal dashboards and admin tools
Integrations between ERP, CRM, email, and shipping
Marketing sites that load fast and rank
Built on Next.js, Supabase, Vercel
